sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，你每天都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，然后你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: A few days ago, when the House Committee investigating January 6th issued a subpoena to Donald Trump, it raised an untested legal question.
sentences.zh: 几天前，当调查1月6日事件的众议院委员会向唐纳德·特朗普发出传票时，它提出了一个未经检验的法律问题。

sentences.en: Can Congress compel a former president to testify?
sentences.zh: 国会能强制要求前总统作证吗？

sentences.en: My colleague, Luke Broadwater, has been trying to figure that out.
sentences.zh: 我的同事卢克·布罗德沃特一直在试图弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月26日，星期三。

sentences.en: Luke, the last hearing of the January 6th Committee ended not with any blockbuster revelations, which is what we have been trained to expect from them,
sentences.zh: 卢克，1月6日委员会的最后一次听证会结束时，并没有出现我们预想中那种重磅炸弹式的爆料，

sentences.en: but instead with a vote to subpoena former President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而是以投票决定传唤前总统唐纳德·特朗普告终。

sentences.en: So take us back to that moment and walk us through how the committee explained that momentous decision.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们回到那一刻，详细讲讲委员会是如何解释这一重大决定的。

sentences.en: So almost immediately, as soon as the hearing has gaveled in...
sentences.zh: 几乎就在听证会敲槌开始后不久……

sentences.en: The select committee to investigate the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol will be in order.
sentences.zh: 调查1月6日美国国会大厦遇袭事件的特别委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: I get a text message on my phone from a source who says, scrap whatever you're writing.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一条来自消息人士的短信，说让我把正在写的东西先放一放。

sentences.en: There's going to be a surprise.
sentences.zh: 会有个惊喜。

sentences.en: You know, I start pushing the person a little bit, and I quickly learn that they are getting ready to issue a subpoena to former President Trump at the end of this
sentences.zh: 你知道，我开始稍微追问了一下，很快就得知他们准备在这次

sentences.en: two-and-a-half-hour hearing.
sentences.zh: 两个半小时的听证会结束时，向特朗普前总统发出传票。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I let the editors know.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我通知了编辑们。

sentences.en: I start texting everyone I know, trying to get a second source.
sentences.zh: 我开始给所有认识的人发短信，试图寻找第二个消息来源。

sentences.en: And I'm actually missing some of the hearing as this is going on because I'm in the room trying to listen, trying to take notes, and break a news story at the same time.
sentences.zh: 其实在这一过程中，我错过了一些听证会的内容，因为我当时在现场，既要听，又要记笔记，还要同时发布新闻。

sentences.en: And so we published the story about halfway through the hearing with enough time to start watching
sentences.zh: 所以我们在听证会进行到一半时就发布了报道，留出了足够的时间来观看

sentences.en: Benny Thompson, the chairman, and Liz Cheney, the vice chairwoman, lead the rest of the hearing.
sentences.zh: 主席本尼·汤普森和副主席利兹·切尼主持接下来的听证会。

sentences.en: During this committee's first hearing in July of last year, our witnesses were four police officers who helped repel the riots of January 6th.
sentences.zh: 在去年7月委员会的第一次听证会上，我们的证人是四名帮助击退1月6日暴乱的警官。

sentences.en: And as they're getting close to the end,
sentences.zh: 当他们快要结束时，

sentences.en: Benny Thompson speaks up, and he starts to remind us about why we're here in the first place.
sentences.zh: 本尼·汤普森发言了，他开始提醒我们当初为什么要坐在这里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: He talks about the officers in the front row who are seated right ahead of me who were injured so badly in the attack.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了坐在我正前方第一排的那些在袭击中受重伤的警官。

sentences.en: Officer Hodges was concerned about whether anyone in power had a role.
sentences.zh: 霍奇斯警官当时很担心是否有当权者参与其中。

sentences.en: Officer Dunn put it simply, get to the bottom of what happened.
sentences.zh: 邓恩警官说得很简单，就是要查清到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: We've worked for more than a year to get those answers.
sentences.zh: 我们花了一年多的时间来寻找这些答案。

sentences.en: And then he says, one man is responsible for these things.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，一个人要为这些事情负责。

sentences.en: We have left, no doubt, none that Donald Trump led an effort to upend American democracy that directly resulted in the violence of January 6th.
sentences.zh: 我们毫无疑问地认为，唐纳德·特朗普领导了一场旨在颠覆美国民主的行动，并直接导致了1月6日的暴力事件。

sentences.en: So we want to hear from him.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想听听他的说法。

sentences.en: And then he turns the microphone over to Liz Cheney.
sentences.zh: 然后他把麦克风交给了利兹·切尼。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, our committee now has sufficient information to answer.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我们的委员会现在已经掌握了足够的信息来回答这个问题。

sentences.en: And she lays out the case for why the committee must take this step.
sentences.zh: 她阐述了委员会必须采取这一步骤的理由。

sentences.en: They must issue a subpoena to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们必须向唐纳德·特朗普发出传票。

sentences.en: And she highlights why they need his testimony, because so many of his allies have refused to cooperate with the committee fully.
sentences.zh: 她强调了为什么需要他的证词，因为他的许多盟友都拒绝与委员会充分合作。

sentences.en: She says more than 30 of them have invoked the Fifth Amendment against self-incrimination to refuse to answer the committee's questions.
sentences.zh: 她说，他们中有超过30人援引了宪法第五修正案中关于防止自证其罪的条款，拒绝回答委员会的问题。

sentences.en: And she points out that others have refused to come in at all and are facing contempt of Congress charges.
sentences.zh: 她还指出，其他人甚至拒绝出席，并正面临藐视国会的指控。

sentences.en: So she says, we still have unanswered questions and the American people have unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 所以她说，我们仍有未解的问题，美国人民也有未解的问题。

sentences.en: And every American is entitled to those answers so we can act now to protect our republic.
sentences.zh: 每一位美国人都理应得到这些答案，这样我们现在才能采取行动保护我们的共和国。

sentences.en: So this afternoon, I am offering this resolution that the committee direct the chairman to issue a subpoena for relevant documents and testimony under oath from Donald John Trump
sentences.zh: 所以今天下午，我提出这项决议，由委员会指示主席向唐纳德·约翰·特朗普发出传票，要求其提供相关文件和宣誓证词，

sentences.en: in connection with the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol.
sentences.zh: 以配合调查1月6日美国国会大厦遇袭事件。

sentences.en: And after Liz Cheney's speech, the committee members all take a vote.
sentences.zh: 在利兹·切尼发言后，委员会成员进行了投票。

sentences.en: Those in favor will say aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成者请说“赞成”。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: And Republicans and Democrats, all nine of them...
sentences.zh: 共和党人和民主党人，全部九名成员……

sentences.en: In the opinion of the chair, the ayes have it.
sentences.zh: 主席认为，赞成者占多数。

sentences.en: ...vote aye to issue the subpoena to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: ……投票赞成向唐纳德·特朗普发出传票。

sentences.en: And it's a momentous decision because, of course, any subpoena involving the president is just a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大的决定，因为当然，任何涉及总统的传票都是一件大事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in fact, you know, no committee has issued a subpoena to Donald Trump before, despite all the various investigations and impeachments.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道，尽管经历了各种调查和弹劾，此前还没有任何委员会向唐纳德·特朗普发出过传票。

sentences.en: This is the first congressional committee to issue a subpoena to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是第一个向唐纳德·特朗普发出传票的国会委员会。

sentences.en: So it was a significant step.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个重要的步骤。

sentences.en: And the subpoena seeks a wide variety of documents from Donald Trump that must be turned in by November 4th, ahead of the midterm election.
sentences.zh: 该传票要求唐纳德·特朗普在11月4日中期选举前提交各种文件。

sentences.en: Then,
sentences.zh: 然后，

sentences.en: 10 days later, they have set on the calendar a deposition date for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 10天后，他们在日程表上为唐纳德·特朗普设定了作证日期。

sentences.en: November 14th, he is summoned to appear before the House committee investigating the January 6th attack on the Capitol for what the committee says
sentences.zh: 11月14日，他被传唤到调查1月6日国会大厦遇袭事件的众议院委员会面前，委员会称

sentences.en: could be a multiple-day interview.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一场持续多日的访谈。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Multiple days.
sentences.zh: 多日。

sentences.en: That's how long they think it's going to take.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这需要这么长时间。

sentences.en: They've blocked out three on their calendar.
sentences.zh: 他们在日程表上预留了三天时间。

sentences.en: So, Luke, given what the committee has uncovered so far, and given what we know about the case that they are building,
sentences.zh: 那么，卢克，考虑到委员会目前所揭露的一切，以及我们对他们正在构建的案件的了解，

sentences.en: what's our understanding of what they think they can get from Trump in these documents or in these three days of testimony that will kind of help them finish out this work?
sentences.zh: 我们认为他们能从特朗普那里得到什么文件，或者在这三天的证词中得到什么，能帮助他们完成这项工作？

sentences.en: Well, the committee has learned a lot about January 6th and the buildup to it, but they still have some big holes in their investigation, and a lot of them concern things
sentences.zh: 嗯，委员会对1月6日事件及其酝酿过程了解了很多，但他们的调查中仍有一些巨大的漏洞，其中许多都涉及

sentences.en: that they can only get from Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 只有唐纳德·特朗普才能提供的东西。

sentences.en: For instance, they've uncovered emails and communications that show Donald Trump and some of his allies were planning to undermine the election weeks and months before anybody
sentences.zh: 例如，他们发现了电子邮件和通讯记录，显示唐纳德·特朗普和他的一些盟友在任何人

sentences.en: cast any votes.
sentences.zh: 投票前数周甚至数月，就已经在策划破坏选举了。

sentences.en: Why was that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: What was in Donald Trump's mind at the time?
sentences.zh: 当时唐纳德·特朗普在想什么？

sentences.en: Why was he so intent on subverting people's faith in the voting at the time?
sentences.zh: 为什么他当时那么执着于颠覆人们对投票的信任？

sentences.en: There are several different conversations he had where different
sentences.zh: 他曾进行过几次不同的谈话，期间不同的

sentences.en: Justice Department officials, and experts tell him things he is saying about voting fraud are wrong, that these things didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 司法部官员和专家告诉他，他所说的关于选举舞弊的事情是错误的，这些事情并没有发生。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Why did he continue to lie about that after learning it was false?
sentences.zh: 为什么他在得知那是谎言后，还要继续撒谎？

sentences.en: I'm sure they'd like to ask him about that.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们很想问他这个问题。

sentences.en: How involved was he in the plan to put forward fake electors?
sentences.zh: 他在提出虚假选举人名单的计划中参与程度有多深？

sentences.en: Why did he entertain seizing voting machines?
sentences.zh: 他为什么会考虑扣押投票机？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why did he amass a crowd of people to come to the Capitol on January 6th?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要聚集一大群人于1月6日来到国会大厦？

sentences.en: And once they turned violent, why did he wait so long to call them off?
sentences.zh: 当他们变得暴力时，他为什么等了那么久才叫停他们？

sentences.en: Specifically, they want to ask him about a tweet he sent at 2.24 in the afternoon while the Capitol was under siege, and he railed against Mike Pence, the vice president,
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他们想问他关于他在下午2点24分发送的一条推文，当时国会大厦正处于围困之中，他在推文中抨击了副总统迈克·彭斯，

sentences.en: in that tweet.
sentences.zh: 在那条推文中。

sentences.en: Why did he do that?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: Didn't he think that was dangerous?
sentences.zh: 他难道不觉得那很危险吗？

sentences.en: Didn't he think that was irresponsible?
sentences.zh: 他难道不觉得那很不负责任吗？

sentences.en: So these are the type of questions they want to ask him, and there's only one man who knows the answers to these questions, and that's the person at the center of it all.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是他们想问他的问题，而只有一个人知道这些问题的答案，那就是处于这一切中心的人。

sentences.en: That's Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 那就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And supposing they get him to offer some answers, how would those answers in theory fit into the question of actual criminal charges, which you have told us this committee
sentences.zh: 假设他们让他给出了一些答案，理论上这些答案将如何融入实际刑事指控的问题中？你曾告诉我们，委员会

sentences.en: may ultimately recommend be brought against Trump at the end of this process?
sentences.zh: 最终可能会建议对特朗普提起这些指控？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So with respect to several of the criminal charges that they've been considering, for instance, obstructing an official proceeding of Congress and conspiracy to defraud
sentences.zh: 关于他们正在考虑的几项刑事指控，例如妨碍国会官方程序和共谋欺诈

sentences.en: the United States, both of those could rest on Donald Trump's mindset and intent during them.
sentences.zh: 美国，这两项指控都可能取决于唐纳德·特朗普在这些事件中的心态和意图。

sentences.en: If he knows what he's doing is false, if he knows the things he's saying are lies, well, that will bolster the case to saying that he was defrauding the American people.
sentences.zh: 如果他知道自己在做的事情是错误的，如果他知道自己所说的话是谎言，那么这将加强对他欺诈美国人民的指控。

sentences.en: And if he intended for this mob to get out of control, for the count to be obstructed, for the proceedings to be delayed, or even encouraged it, or did nothing to stop it,
sentences.zh: 如果他有意让这群暴徒失控，让计票过程受阻，让程序延误，甚至鼓励了这一切，或者什么都没做来阻止它，

sentences.en: that could help bolster the case
sentences.zh: 那将有助于加强

sentences.en: for obstructing an official proceeding of Congress.
sentences.zh: 妨碍国会官方程序的指控。

sentences.en: Right, because as you've told us in the past, Luke, the evidence that the committee has gathered so far, it has frequently told us that Trump knew something or did something
sentences.zh: 没错，因为正如你过去告诉我们的，卢克，委员会迄今收集的证据经常告诉我们，特朗普在1月6日左右

sentences.en: around January 6th, you know, set an event into motion, but it didn't tell us what he wanted to happen.
sentences.zh: 知道些什么或做了些什么，你知道，启动了某个事件，但并没有告诉我们他想要发生什么。

sentences.en: It doesn't tell us his intent.
sentences.zh: 它没有告诉我们他的意图。

sentences.en: Right, and so the committee has tried to fill in those gaps through circumstantial evidence, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，所以委员会试图通过间接证据来填补这些空白，对吧？

sentences.en: We've heard testimony that Donald Trump knew the crowd was armed and yet wanted them to come closer to the stage anyway, right?
sentences.zh: 我们听到的证词显示，唐纳德·特朗普知道人群携带了武器，但还是想让他们靠近舞台，对吧？

sentences.en: And we've heard evidence that he said fight like hell and he seemed to fire up the crowd.
sentences.zh: 我们听到的证据显示，他说要“拼命战斗”，似乎点燃了人群的情绪。

sentences.en: And then we've heard evidence that he was made aware that people were attacking the Capitol and that Vice President
sentences.zh: 然后我们听到的证据显示，他被告知人们正在袭击国会大厦，副总统

sentences.en: Mike Pence's life was in danger and didn't do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯的生命处于危险之中，但他却什么也没做。

sentences.en: But he hasn't really been asked directly
sentences.zh: 但他并没有真正被直接问到

sentences.en: or spoke directly about under oath and under questioning the question of did you want people to attack the Capitol?
sentences.zh: 或者在宣誓和质询下直接谈论过这个问题：你是否希望人们袭击国会大厦？

sentences.en: Did you think it was useful for people to put a bunch of pressure
sentences.zh: 你是否认为让人们施加压力

sentences.en: and intimidate lawmakers into getting what you wanted and that was to stay in office?
sentences.zh: 并恐吓立法者以达到你想要的目的（即留任）是有用的？

sentences.en: You know, we've heard circumstantially about him raging in the SUV because he wants to go to the Capitol, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们曾间接听说他在SUV里发火，因为他想去国会大厦，对吧？

sentences.en: He wants to be with those people.
sentences.zh: 他想和那些人在一起。

sentences.en: Why was he raging?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要发火？

sentences.en: Why was he irate?
sentences.zh: 他为什么那么愤怒？

sentences.en: Mr. President, answer the question.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，回答这个问题。

sentences.en: You can sort of see how this would play out with Liz Cheney on the other end of the table asking him these direct questions under oath.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象一下，如果利兹·切尼坐在桌子的另一端，在宣誓下向他提出这些直接问题，会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Well, given how central Trump's testimony could be to all those charges and questions that you just raised, why do we think the committee waited so long to issue this subpoena?
sentences.zh: 嗯，考虑到特朗普的证词对于你刚才提到的所有指控和问题可能有多关键，为什么我们认为委员会花了这么长时间才发出这张传票？

sentences.en: It's been over a year, right?
sentences.zh: 已经过去一年多了，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, you're right that it's a pretty risky strategy if they're hoping to actually get him to testify because they're running out of time and it's only a little more
sentences.zh: 嗯，你说得对，如果他们真的希望他作证，这确实是一个相当冒险的策略，因为他们的时间不多了，距离委员会解散

sentences.en: than two months before the committee will dissolve.
sentences.zh: 只剩下两个多月了。

sentences.en: So they did gamble on this, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们是在赌这一把。

sentences.en: But the committee's thinking, if you talk to some of the people involved with its work, is that this was how they were building their case.
sentences.zh: 但如果你和一些参与其工作的人交谈，委员会的想法是，这就是他们构建案件的方式。

sentences.en: And so I think it's important for the listeners to remember that it's not just politicians on this committee.
